text:
In June 2026 the median asking rent in Chemnitz stood at 6.1 €/m², up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 15.0 % over the past five years. The market remains slack, with 61 days on market and only 8 % of listings let within a week, while the vacancy rate sits at 9.4 %.

Affordability is moderate: a 60 m² unit costs about 366 €/month, generating a rent‑burden of 8.8 % for two residents. Asking rents are roughly 16 % above the 2022 existing rent of 5.26 €/m², reflecting a modest premium.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 6.21 €/m² in the next 12 months, ranging between 6.07 €/m² and 6.41 €/m², a 1.7 % increase.
